passages.original: 591 ARGUMENTUM. - Memoriam sancti Cypriani Ecclesia colit, cujus non minus doctrina quam sanguine gloriatur. Complures fidelium mortem Cyprianus docuit non timere. Ad omnem sancti Cornelii hoc sufficit laudem , quod apostolicam sedem suo cruore decoravit.
passages.english: ARGUMENT. The Church honours the memory of Saint Cyprian, in whose teaching she glories no less than in his blood. Cyprian taught very many of the faithful not to fear death. For the whole praise of Saint Cornelius this suffices: that he adorned the apostolic see with his blood.
passages.notes: "591" at the start appears to be a page or column number from the printed edition and has not been translated.
